subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal — evidence handoff, retention change, and capacity terms
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: samir.desai@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 4 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 recert + renewal evidence and retention ask

Jonas —

As we get close to our March renewal, security is requesting an updated evidence package for SOC 2 recertification. Two asks from our side: 1) a consolidated index of the SOC 2 evidence artifacts (logs, config snapshots, attestation PDFs) that maps to the 2027 attestation items; and 2) confirmation that Redwood can extend the audit log retention window from 90 days to 365 days for a subset of our tenant data for the next 12 months (we understand there are cost implications).

Can you confirm what you can provide, timing for a handoff, and whether a short-term retention uplift is feasible while we finalize contract terms? If there are options on seat/throughput commitments that make the retention bump more economical, please include those in your response.

Thanks —
Lena Morales
Director, Infosec — Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

(On copy: Samir Desai, Procurement)

From: jonas.weber@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acme-corp.com>, samir.desai@acme-corp.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Thu, 5 Jan 2028 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal evidence and retention ask

Lena —

Thanks for the clear ask. Short answers up front: we can produce a consolidated evidence index and we can support a 365-day audit-log retention carveout for Acme for a defined subset of telemetry. There are three pieces to align on: scope (exact types of logs + tenant data), storage/egress cost, and the contract amendment (term/seat commitments) to cover the uplift.

Proposed next steps:
- I'll attach a draft evidence index schema to map to the SOC 2 control families (see attachment).
- Can we schedule a 30-min sync next week with Security + Procurement to agree scope? Laura (Security PM) and Karthik (Customer Success) are looped for operational details and commercial options.

If Acme is open to a 12-month seat/usage commit (we can outline a 10% discount band), we can amortize the retention cost and keep monthly billing predictable. I opened a provisional deal record ACME-2028-RNW and will prepare two options: retention-as-addon (pay-as-you-go) and retention-included-with-seat-commit.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.example.com
+1 415-555-0183

Attachments: evidence-index-template.csv (draft)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acme-corp.com>, jonas.weber@redwood.example.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com, samir.desai@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 6 Jan 2028 14:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal evidence and retention ask

Lena / team —

Adding operational detail here. Attached is the evidence-index export (CSV) populated with the 2027 items we use for other customers; it includes object paths, snapshot timestamps, and whether the artifact is archived or live. For the log-retention carveout we need to define:

1) Data subset: app-logs + auth-kv + request-trace metadata tied to Acme tenant IDs (we do not include full PII payloads).
2) Retention lifecycle: 365 days in hot storage with rollup archive at day 180 for cost savings.
3) Access controls: logs will be available via a read-only export job and via our compliance console.

Operational impact: uplift for the subset is roughly an incremental 0.08 USD per 1K requests retained per month (ballpark; final number after telemetry sampling). If you want a firm quote, we need a 14-day telemetry sample to size the retention footprint.

I'll also include the small retention-policy diff doc that legal can reference for the amendment. Jonas — can you confirm the commercial packaging options and whether finance needs a formal PO before we enact the retention change?

--
Laura Bennett
Security PM, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.example.com

Attachments: evidence-index-ACME.csv, retention-policy-diffs.docx

From: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acme-corp.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.example.com, laura.bennett@redwood.example.com
Cc: samir.desai@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 9 Jan 2028 11:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal evidence and retention ask

Jonas / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for the attachments. A few clarifying items before the sync:

- The subset looks good but we need auth-kv for the last 12 months for token-revocation audits.
- Can you confirm whether archived rollups preserve the original request-id mapping (we depend on that for incident reconstruction)?
- On pricing: Samir — will Redwood accept a 12-month commitment for 150 committed seats at the discount band? If so, we'll route an internal endorsement.

We'll take a 14-day telemetry sample — can you give us an ETA on that and the format? Also please include a sample compliance export (anonymized) so our auditors can validate format.

Lena
Director, Infosec — Acme Corp

PS: Samir — once Jonas confirms commercial options, can you advise on any procurement cadence constraints?

From: jonas.weber@redwood.example.com
To: Lena Morales <lena.morales@acme-corp.com>, samir.desai@acme-corp.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.example.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.example.com
Date: Fri, 12 Jan 2028 15:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 recert + renewal evidence and retention ask

Lena / Samir —

Great — quick updates and commitments:

1) Telemetry sample: we can deliver a 14-day anonymized telemetry export in CSV + gz format by Jan 20 (we'll scrub PII and supply a mapping doc). Format link: https://drive.redwood.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-evidence

2) Archived rollups: yes — rollups include request-id mapping for the first 18 months; we will preserve request-id pointers so incident reconstruction is possible. We'll document the exact retention lifecycle in the retention-policy-diffs.docx (attached).

3) Commercial options: two clean paths —
   A) Commitment plan: 12-month commitment for 150 seats (usage floor) at 10% discount; retention uplift included for the defined subset. We can publish a short SOW + capacity amendment and roll it into the renewal.
   B) Pay-as-you-go: retention uplift enabled immediately; usage billed monthly at incremental rates (no discount).

If Procurement confirms a PO for path A by Jan 26 we can lock in the retention change to align with your March renewal and include a one-time migration credit to offset the telemetry sample effort. Otherwise, we proceed with path B and get the sample running immediately.

Next: I'll prepare the SOW template and a short amendment draft for Legal. Karthik will follow up on implementation timeline once you pick a path.

Thanks —
Jonas
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.example.com

Attachments: SOC2-2027-bridge-letter.pdf, evidence-index-ACME.csv
